title: Refill autonomy backlog templates (2026-05-10 v3)
summary: Autonomy sessions are stalled again because every previously-seeded backlog template already exists under agent-os/autonomy/tasks. Append a fresh batch of alpha-critical templates grounded in docs/status gaps so autonomy-next can keep seeding new work without chat context.
expectedFailureModes: Autonomy sessions stall because backlog exhaustion prevents seeding new tasks.
